title: [Khuvar]/Choara/Apameia (Rhagiane)?
description: BAtlas places this Parthian settlement "near Aradan" and tentatively collates Apameia and Choara, although Pliny makes the two distinct. Isidore does place Apameia in the vicinity of Choara.
